name: cass-prod
description: Production Cassandra, read-only role. Replace REPLACE_CASSANDRA_RO_ROLE (twice: credentials and readonly_probe) and REPLACE_CASSANDRA_HOST. If that role may not LIST its own permissions, ask the Cassandra admin for a probe statement that fails for a writer and succeeds for a reader. SOURCE, COPY, CAPTURE and LOGIN are cqlsh meta-commands that read or write files as the daemon's own uid; they stay in blocked_patterns.
